title: Round 2 · v2
meta: a second, fresh critic · 1 to 24 fps, motion and pan measured, sound by measurement
gap: The refusal of "come in" is a near non-event: a small head lift outward, head down, then up again. It never looks into the house, so refusal cannot be told from not hearing.
repair: Within 1 s of the prompt: the head turns at least 30° toward the lit interior and holds 6 frames, or the tail sweeps twice; within 1.5 s more it turns back out and lowers onto the paws; it does not rise again before the scene ends; in a 320 px still of the last frame the dog crosses a jamb with at least a quarter of its length on each side.
notes: 32.9 and 37.2 s: reframes of about 60 px inside one shot read as jump cuts.
31.8–32.0 s: the person's sit pops from a squat to a chair-sit in mid-air.
6.3 s: two copies of the caption at once; 14.5 and 17.5 s: the title over half-faded tags.
33.4–34.0 s: getting up and turning in 0.6 s is too fast to read as a decision.
Sound: near-silence under the lineage (5.5–11 s); a loud 2 Hz pulse from 54 s that no visible tail matches.
Credits and the PEO diagram label: too small, and a label runs into a border.
keep: The caption lift-off as one travelling object; the refusal close-up; the continuous approach and lie-down; the clean head-lower at 57.3 s; the nested scales card; the title card.
done: The dog now turns its head in through the door with its tail sweeping, then puts its chin down and keeps it down; the sill moved so its back third lies outside the jamb; the reframes became moves; the sit squats first; the turn waits until the dog is up and takes longer; a pad and tag sounds under the lineage; tail thumps only when the tail sweeps; bigger type.
